# motion-recipes — path-specific instructions

After `motion-design-taste` has set the three dials and chosen a motion mode, pick one of the eight clone-able recipes as the starting skeleton instead of writing from scratch:

| Recipe | When | Key plugins |
|---|---|---|
| **Editorial Kinetic** | Editorial / agency / portfolio with strong typography | SplitText, ScrollTrigger |
| **Brutalist Scroll** | Heavy, raw, high-design-variance | Pinned ScrollTrigger, Flip |
| **Liquid Glass Hover** | Premium / dark-tech / Apple-inspired | quickTo, backdrop-filter |
| **Bento Flip** | Product / dashboard / feature grid | ScrollTrigger.batch, Flip |
| **Minimal Fade** | B2B SaaS / public-sector / accessibility-first | autoAlpha, small `y` |
| **Cinematic Pinned Scrub** | Awwwards-style scroll story | pin + scrub, MorphSVG, multi-layer parallax |
| **Kinetic Type Stagger** | Bold landing / single statement | SplitText (chars), expo.out stagger |
| **Grid Break Overlap** | Magazine-style asymmetric layout | ScrollTrigger, differential `y` |

Each recipe ships dial values, type pool, color rule, layout pattern, motion language band, and a code skeleton. Clone and override only what the brief specifies.

For full skeletons: `skills/motion-recipes/SKILL.md`.
